entities.name: Manticore
entities.description: Sentient, ill-tempered monsters with lion-like bodies, a scorpion's tail, a human face and razor-sharp teeth.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Plane whose manticores are used in the trials of the five gods.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: His army of Eternals included zombified manticores.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: Attacked by a manticore on Corondor.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: Said to have forged the manticore's tail, teeth and heart.

events.summary: A crimson manticore serving Geyadrone Dihada attacks Dakkon Blackblade on Corondor and is killed.
